Senior Fullstack Developer


Location: Hybrid (Petach Tikva, Israel) | Experience: 5+ years | Full-Time

Dreamhub is the first AI-native CRM purpose-built for B2B SaaS teams. Backed by the founders of MuleSoft, Datadog, and Datorama, weâre redefining how go-to-market teams operateâleveraging machine learning and LLMs to automate workflows, surface deep insights, and eliminate manual data entry.

What You'll Do:
